prompt: One square detailed naturalistic oil-painted encyclopedia illustration of SAMEBITO exactly from Lafcadio Hearn's shark-person tale. One MALE humanoid shark-person with BLACK SKIN, bright EMERALD EYES, a DEMONLIKE fearsome face and long DRAGONLIKE BEARD. Humanlike body with two arms and two legs, modest simple old Japanese cloth; no dorsal fin or tail invented. His fearsome appearance must coexist with a GENTLE SAD demeanor: slumped shoulders, grieving emerald eyes, one hand holding tiny RUBIES formed from tears, delicate reddish tear drops on cheeks. Alone by quiet old Japanese waterside. Detailed realistic textures and exquisite brushwork, sorrowful gentle sea exile atmosphere, not aggressive horror. Full central form comfortably in frame. No horns, wings, weapons, attack, shark mouth substituted for beard, armor, sea king crown, extra limbs, gore, text, watermark or labels.
visual_requirements: Black skin, emerald eyes and dragonlike beard
Gentle grieving demeanor and ruby tears
aura: Gentle sorrowful sea exile despite fearsome visage

visual_review.notes: Observed black-skinned robust male humanoid with clearly emerald eyes, heavy fearsome brow and long flowing dragonlike beard. Reddish tears on cheeks and tiny rubies in hand; slumped seated posture and sad downcast gaze create gentle grief rather than aggression. No invented dorsal fin, horns or weapons.
